facts.fact: Niger's Loi 2019-03 of 30 April 2019 on electronic transactions, promulgated and published in the Journal Officiel (Art. 55), has a Title VII on electronic administration: Art. 29 lets administrations exchange information, documents and acts electronically, and Art. 35 institutes a General Interoperability Framework (RGI) for administrative information systems, to be set by decree.

Art. 33 of Niger's Loi 2019-03 of 30 April 2019 exempts an applicant from supplying a supporting document when the administration can obtain it directly from the administration or services concerned, replacing it with a sworn declaration; Art. 35 has the RGI data directories, norms and standards 'qui doivent etre utilises par l'administration'.
